question: Which country has declared the Humboldt penguin as an endangered species, warning of further population decline due to habitat loss, fishing competition, and climate change?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chile.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Chile has declared the Humboldt penguin an endangered species, as scientists warn of sharp declines in its population along the Pacific coast.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chile is home to about 80% of the world’s remaining Humboldt penguins, whose population has dropped below 20,000 from around 45,000 in the late 1990s.**
 
• Chile’s Environment Ministry recently reclassified the species from “vulnerable” to “endangered.”
 
• The species faces threats from overfishing, pollution, bird flu, and the worsening impacts of climate change.
 
• Experts at Universidad de Concepcion and the National Zoo have called for stricter legislation to protect the species and ensure sustainable fishing practices.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Humboldt Penguin (Spheniscus humboldti):**__

 __
 
• Scientific Name: *Spheniscus humboldti*
 
• Family: Spheniscidae
 
• Order: Sphenisciformes
 
• IUCN Conservation Status: Vulnerable
 
 
 
• **Habitat:**__ Found along the coasts of Chile and Peru, especially on rocky, temperate shorelines of the Pacific Ocean.
 
• __**Main Threats:**__ Habitat destruction, overfishing reducing food availability, pollution, oil spills, entanglement in fishing nets, and climate change effects.
 
• __**Conservation Efforts:**__ Reclassification to “endangered” calls for stronger protection laws, regulated fishing, and habitat preservation to prevent further decline.
